Debug._comment: DetailedErrors=true returns full 401/403/500 diagnostics in responses. Dev only — enable via `dotnet user-secrets set Debug:DetailedErrors true`, never in production.

ConnectionStrings._comment: TODO(form-generator): set the real Azure SQL / local SQL Server connection strings via `dotnet user-secrets` (dev) or Azure App Service Configuration (prod) — never here.

Razorpay._comment: TODO(form-generator): set via user-secrets / Azure App Service Configuration — never here. KeySecret must stay server-side only.

Cashfree._comment: Two key pairs, one per environment: Sandbox (test) and Production (live). Set them via `dotnet user-secrets` (dev) or Azure App Service config Cashfree__Sandbox__AppId / Cashfree__Sandbox__SecretKey / Cashfree__Production__AppId / Cashfree__Production__SecretKey (prod) — never here. Admin → Payment settings → Environment picks which pair (and which Cashfree URL) is used; both secrets verify webhook signatures. A plain Cashfree:AppId / Cashfree:SecretKey still works as the fallback for either. Cashfree fills {order_id} in ReturnUrl (prod: https://archaeotrails.com/booking/{order_id}). NotifyUrl = https://<api-host>/api/payments/cashfree/webhook — must be public https; leave REPLACE_ME to skip it (local dev).

Bookings._comment: HoldMinutes = how long an unpaid booking keeps its seats/date (production: 15; local dev overrides it to 2 in appsettings.Development.json). The expiry worker runs every ExpirySweepMinutes and gives a hold ExpiryGraceMinutes extra before marking it Expired.

Cors._comment: Browser origins allowed to call the API. Add one in production via App Service settings (Cors__AllowedOrigins__3 = https://…) — no code change.

Jwt._comment: TODO(admin-panel): real values must come from User Secrets in Development or Azure App Service Configuration in Production. Never store real secrets here.

Sanity._comment: TODO(experiences): set Sanity:WriteToken via user-secrets / Azure App Service Configuration — never here, and never expose it to the frontend. ProjectId/Dataset match UI/src/sanityClient.js.

SeedAdmin._comment: TODO(admin-panel): real values must come from User Secrets in Development or Azure App Service Configuration in Production. Never store real secrets here. Left as REPLACE_ME, no initial Admin account is seeded — see IdentitySeeder.cs. UserName is the login handle for that first Admin (separate from Email); it is not a secret, and falls back to "admin" if unset.
